notes:
- Company: global travel marketplace (air/hotel + local experiences). High season spikes (holiday windows) cause 6-8x traffic bursts.
- Primary ask: multilingual agent assist + ticket summarization + automated tool-calls into CRM/ota tools (create reservation/change itinerary).
- Languages: en, es (LATAM), pt-BR, fr, de, zh-CN, hi. Tone must be locale-aware (formal vs. informal variants) — product wants 'locale templates' per market.
- Latency targets: user-facing assistant responses p95 <250ms; backend tool-calls batchable but must complete within 3s for agent UI.
- Throughput: baseline 2k concurrent agent sessions, spike to 12k during promotions. Cost sensitivity: moderate; willing to pay for reliability during spikes.
- Model preferences: smaller LLMs for ticket summarization + embeddings; larger, optimized generations for agent assist with tool-calling. Seeking model/catalog guidance + quantization suggestions.
- Routing: regional routing by user locale and account tier; EU data must remain in EU for EU users (data residency). Fallthrough to US-hosted models only after consent and with PII redaction.
- Security: strict audit logs, SAML SSO integration with Okta, KMS for key management, 2-year retention for audit trails.
- Quote from Head of CX: "We need answers that sound local — not just literal translations. Tone and small cultural cues matter for loyalty."
- Existing stack: Zendesk + in-house CRM, Kafka event backbone, AWS in NA/EU. Wants Redwood to call internal orchestration endpoints for reservation changes (tool-calling) with idempotency.
- POC success criteria: 1) maintain p95 <250ms under synthetic 8x spike for 3 days, 2) human eval score >=85% on locale-appropriate tone, 3) end-to-end tool-call reliability >=99.5% during POC
- Risks called out: customer needs proof of regional routing correctness and per-tenant data segregation for Dedicated offering.
- Commercial: prefers annual commit for dedicated pool after successful POC; asked for burst pricing model and fallback SLAs.
summary: Enterprise travel marketplace evaluating Redwood for multilingual contact center automation. Focus: agent assist, ticket summarization, tool-calls into OTA systems, and robust handling of holiday traffic spikes with EU/LATAM data residency and locale-aware tone.
